name: Dessa Wyck
role: Captain of the Switchback Tollmen — runs the toll on the old high road and skims the tribute she sends the Gralloch
appearance: Lean and weather-dark, a crossbow across her back and a ledger in her coat. Sits on the chain post when she talks, so you have to look up at her.
voiceHints: Prices things out loud. Treats every conversation as a negotiation she expects to win, and is cheerful about it.
wants: To get off the mountain with enough put by that nobody can take it back — before the King notices the tribute is light.
knowledge: Who has come down from the high pass this season, and what they carried
Exactly how much the Gralloch is owed, and exactly how much it has been sent
That something on the upper switchback takes strange objects from packs and leaves the food, and that it is not her people

reactsToReputation.any: sets the toll by what you look like you can pay
reactsToReputation.feared: waves you through and remembers your face
reactsToReputation.generous: doubles the toll and calls it respect

questSeeds: Dessa has been skimming a fifth of the Gralloch's tribute for three seasons
The Tollmen would switch sides for a captain who could keep the King off them
gear: a toll ledger in her own cipher
title: Captain of the Switchback Tollmen
_domainsWhy: a toll-captain: the Marchers' edge, the Bargainers' price named aloud, and a road people
